summary.motive: Exploit aggressive linebacker run fits by pairing a hard split-zone play-action fake with a clear-out post and intermediate Dagger (dig) route.
summary.whyItWorks: The split-zone mesh pulls linebackers 5-8 yards downhill toward the line of scrimmage, while the tight end clear-out post occupies the single-high safety deep. The Dagger route breaks into the wide open intermediate void between the two levels.
summary.failureMode: A disciplined Mike LB dropping under the dig route, or immediate edge pressure beating the play-action protection.

beats.title: Identical Condensed Split-Zone Look
beats.text: Offense shows the exact same 12-personnel condensed formation and under-center posture that established the base Split-Zone run.

beats.title: The Deceptive Split-Zone Mesh
beats.text: Offensive line sells lateral stretch right while H-Back slices across. Mike and Will linebackers sprint downhill into the line to plug the run.

beats.title: The Linebacker Trap & Play-Action Pull
beats.text: QB violently pulls the ball at t=1.3s and steps into a deep 5-step pocket. The linebackers are trapped 10 yards out of position near the line of scrimmage.

beats.title: The Clear-Out Post Drags the Deep Safety
beats.text: Inline TE stems vertical on a deep post, turning the single-high Free Safety away from the middle of the field and opening a massive intermediate passing window.

beats.title: The Dagger Strike into the Void
beats.text: Backside X snaps off a crisp 15-yard Dagger right behind the stranded linebackers and underneath the cleared-out safety for an explosive 25-yard gain.

relations.tell: Backside X stems vertical into intermediate Dagger instead of stalk blocking; QB pulls ball at t=1.3s.
